messages:
sophie_csm: Heads-up — Morningside account health trending down. Usage down ~48% MoM, their primary advocate (Aaron) left two weeks ago, new procurement lead onboarding. They're running a Lexicore pilot next week. Need quick renewal triage + recommended playbook. cc @ajay_ae
ajay_ae: On it. Do we have concrete numbers (QPS / tokens) and are they on Hosted or Dedicated?
sophie_csm: Hosted. model=redwood-1.4x, avg latency ~120ms. Dashboard: https://console.redwood/morningside/usage (internal). Token usage last 30d = 220k vs 420k previous.
ops-bot: Alert: account:morningside usage_drop=48% severity=medium
nora_revops: :eyes: I can pull billing & seat history. Quick q — renewal window is Aug 10, 2026, right? Need to verify contract terms before offering promos.
ajay_ae: Yes Aug 10. Scheduling a call with new procurement + CTO for Tue next week. Sophie — can you prep product health + ROI slides? I'll loop legal if pricing comes up.
ravi_se: Quick engineering check — any 5xx/error spikes or rate limits? If their nightly sync is being throttled we should surface that. Also curious about KV cache hit rate.
sophie_csm: No big 5xx spikes. Small uptick in 429s last week. Snippet from logs:
```
429 rate_limit exceeded route=/generate burst=120/100
```
ravi_se: That would explain reduced observed usage — requests getting throttled. Two immediate options: raise their burst limit on Hosted or propose a short Dedicated trial (better throughput). I can draft a config change + perf deltas. Also recommend prefix KV caching and enabling 8-bit quant for cost savings.
ajay_ae: Can we package that as a short pilot offer (30 days Dedicated trial) + price protection? Might beat Lexicore's cost argument.
nora_revops: We do have a 'burst trial' promo in the catalog — requires AE + CSM sign-off and RevOps approval. Sophie, include estimated $ impact and expected token delta if we apply caching + quant.
sophie_csm: Will add numbers. Also capturing customer sentiment: in last call they said "Lexicore cheaper and faster for bulk syncs" — so we should lead with reliability + observability + E2E latency for batch jobs in the deck.
ajay_ae: :thumbsup: I'll own the call next week. Goal is to get a CTO-level commitment or a short extension of current POC. If procurement pushes on price, escalate to sales_ops.
ravi_se: I'll prepare a short patch (config + recommended limits) and report expected latency/token reduction.
sophie_csm: Thanks — I'll share a draft playbook in this thread by EOD and schedule a prep sync tomorrow 10am PT.
ajay_ae: :rocket:
